prompt_instructions: Consult orchestration/vscode_orchestration_gpt5/restricted_files_orchestrator.json before editing any shared file.
Do not modify files listed in the restricted registry unless the orchestrator explicitly delegates the edit.
Reserve files by running python -m orchestration.vscode_orchestration_gpt5.busy_ledgers mark-busy <tab_id> <path> before edits and mark-free afterward.
Log outcomes in completed_tab_<tab_id>.json and capture follow-up proposals in task_proposal_tab_<tab_id>.json before handing work back to the orchestrator.
